Skill `linear`.
Roles: `agent`, `user`.
Tool `configure_linear_mcp` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; needs `shell`, `linux`, `local_filesystem`, `package_registries`, `allowlisted_internet`; adds `linear_mcp_configured`.
Tool `enable_rmcp_client` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; needs `shell`, `linux`, `local_filesystem`; requires `linear_mcp_configured`; adds `rmcp_client_enabled`.
Tool `login_linear_mcp` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; needs `shell`, `linux`, `allowlisted_internet`, `user_conversation`; requires `linear_mcp_configured` and `rmcp_client_enabled`; adds `linear_mcp_logged_in`.
Tool `ask_user_for_scope` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; needs `user_conversation`; adds `goal_clarified`, `scope_confirmed`.
Tool `ask_user_for_identifiers` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; needs `user_conversation`; requires `goal_clarified`; adds `identifiers_confirmed`.
Tool `read_linear_context` (owner `agent`): via `mcp_resources`; requires `linear_mcp_logged_in` and `scope_confirmed` and `identifiers_confirmed`; adds `context_built`.
Tool `apply_linear_changes` (owner `agent`): via `mcp_resources`; requires `linear_mcp_logged_in` and `context_built`; adds `linear_changes_applied`.
Tool `summarize_results` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; needs `user_conversation`; requires any of (`context_built`, `linear_changes_applied`); adds `results_summarized`, `next_actions_proposed`.
Initially true: none.
Goal: any of ((`linear_mcp_logged_in` and `results_summarized`), (`context_built` and `results_summarized`), (`linear_changes_applied` and `results_summarized`)).
Protocol:
  - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `mcp_already_ready`: none.
    - branch `mcp_not_ready`:
      - `agent` uses `configure_linear_mcp`.
      - `agent` uses `enable_rmcp_client`.
      - `agent` uses `login_linear_mcp`.
  - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `restart_required_after_login`:
      - `agent` uses `summarize_results`.
    - branch `continue_workflow`:
      - `agent` uses `ask_user_for_scope`.
      - `agent` uses `ask_user_for_identifiers`.
      - `agent` uses `read_linear_context`.
      - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `read_only_request`: none.
        - branch `update_request`:
          - `agent` uses `apply_linear_changes`.
      - `agent` uses `summarize_results`.
